competition_design.name: NFL Line-Origination Leaderboard (season 2026)
competition_design.scoring: Each registered strategy earns 1,000 reward points only if it passes ALL 10 pre-registered gates on the frozen holdout. Partial credit: 0. Points are reputation/karma within this research project; no monetary prizes are funded (flag F-04).
competition_design.anti_luck_rule: A strategy cannot place on the leaderboard from in-sample performance, from fewer than 300 graded selections, or without beating the 95th percentile of 10,000 placebo runs. This is what removes luck from the ranking.

reward_pool.note: 0 of 6,000 points awarded — no strategy passes all gates (2026-11-13 run).
